subject.title: [Feature]: Add Ralph Loop feature and add max iteration number into the agent configuration

question: Should OpenClaw support only the bounded per-agent iteration-budget direction, or also add a distinct repeated-prompt Ralph lifecycle that runs until an explicit STOP?
rationale: The active candidate addresses the safety-limit portion, while the requested repeated-prompt behavior has different lifecycle, interruption, and session-state semantics that cannot be chosen from source evidence alone.

options.title: Budget as canonical
options.body: Treat the bounded tool-calling-round budget as the core feature and avoid a separate Ralph mode unless a distinct unsupported use case is demonstrated.

options.title: Add bounded Ralph mode
options.body: Define a separate repeated-prompt lifecycle with explicit STOP handling, interruption, persistence, and a finite default cap before implementation.

recommendation.title: Budget as canonical
recommendation.body: Treat the bounded tool-calling-round budget as the core feature and avoid a separate Ralph mode unless a distinct unsupported use case is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: They previously reviewed this exact product/config question and are connected to current configuration and loop-safety history.
